purpose: matched compiled replay geography/event-cap and retained ownership trial

limitations: Synthetic connected pilot; no ESI traffic or real player credentials.
Headless Linux software rendering; no desktop GPU/FPS claim.
CDP TaskDuration covers renderer main-thread tasks, not total browser/worker/GPU CPU.

Two synthetic pilots each own 25/100-node maps. Replay uses1000 visits at60-second spacing. repeat-small uses200 events; repeat-cap/distinct-cap use10000. Distinct geography uses1000 different known systems and does not claim confirmed gate travel.
Browser HTTPS and known image CDN HTTP requests blocked using CDP; application CSP restricts connections to same-origin.
Instrumentation: canvas clearRect counter and long-task observer, CDP metrics and network events; no CPU profile. Forced GC, DOM counters and global listener inspection run outside timed samples.
Idle samples have no RAF probe. Interaction samples have an RAF interval observer; identical for all sizes.
Retention snapshots use three explicit GC passes after two seconds on Overview; this is retained-heap diagnosis, not natural-GC memory or desktop residency. No leak inference from RSS.

retentionMethod.gcTiming: Separate retained-heap diagnostic: forced GC on warmed Overview, exact-end mounted replay, and Overview ownership checkpoints. Its timing samples are not ordinary performance evidence.
retentionMethod.expectedStable: Global window/document listener signatures; no map/replay DOM on Overview; no universe requests after scoped event while unmounted. Browser internal cache growth may remain.
